title: The experience of rendering Arabic typography and its technical debt
summary: A technical deep-dive into the challenges of rendering Arabic typography on the web, exploring the complexities of bidirectional text, ligatures, and contextual letter forms that create significant technical debt for developers.
problem_solved: The difficulty of properly implementing Arabic script rendering with its complex rules for letter forms, diacritics, and bidirectional text flow.
why_valuable: Arabic typography presents unique technical challenges that are often overlooked, and this article provides practical insights for developers dealing with RTL languages and internationalization.
